segments.ja: トロスト区の街は、昼なのに静かでした。外門の扉は折れ、壁には大きな穴が開いたままです。超大型巨人がその門を破壊してから、巨人は何体も通りの奥まで入っています。駐屯兵団の兵士たちは屋根に腹ばいになり、立体機動装置のワイヤーだけを頼りに息をひそめていました。壁の上に残った兵も、下を見たまま声が出ません。この穴を塞がなければ、ウォール・ローゼの内側は、今夜も巨人の通り道です。ただ、兵士たちの目が向いていたのは、穴だけではありませんでした。
segments.en: Trost District was quiet, even though it was still day. The outer gate was broken, and a huge hole stood open in the wall. After the Colossal Titan destroyed that gate, titans walked deep into the streets. Soldiers of the Garrison Regiment lay flat on the roofs, trusting nothing but the cables of their ODM gear, and they kept their breath small. The soldiers left on top of the wall looked down and could not speak. If nobody plugged that hole, the inside of Wall Rose would stay a road for titans tonight. But the hole was not the only thing those soldiers were staring at.

segments.ja: 砲が狙っているのは、外から来た敵ではありません。訓練兵団で同じ食事をとっていた、エレン・イェーガーです。エレンは巨人の体のうなじから、人間の姿で出てきました。体は熱く、まわりには白い蒸気が残っています。彼は仲間の名前を呼ぼうとしますが、言葉より先に、兵士の恐怖が広がります。人間の顔がある。それなのに、巨人の力を持っている。見ていた兵にとって、その二つは同時に成立しませんでした。ミカサ・アッカーマンはエレンの前に回り込みたかったのですが、砲の狙いが先に決まっていきます。ここでの死は、巨人に食われる死ではありません。人間の判断で下される死です。
segments.en: The cannon was not aimed at an enemy from outside. It was aimed at Eren Jaeger, a boy who had eaten the same meals in the Training Corps. Eren had come out of the nape of a Titan's body, human-shaped again. He was hot to look at, and white steam still hung around him. He tried to call his friends' names, but the soldiers' terror moved faster than his words. There was a human face. And there was a Titan's power. For the soldiers watching, those two facts could not both be true. Mikasa Ackerman wanted to get in front of Eren, but the cannon's aim was settling first. Death here would not be a death inside a Titan's mouth. It would be a death decided by human judgment.

segments.ja: 列を割って前に出たのは、アルミン・アルレルトです。声は震えています。それでもアルミンは、兵士たちに同じことを繰り返しました。エレンは人間のままで、人類の側にいる、と。今この場でエレンを殺せば、穴を塞ぐ手段まで失う、と。アルミンは英雄の演説をしていません。友達を死刑から引き戻すために、作戦の価値だけを短く置いています。聞いている兵の何人かは、アルミンを危険な味方だと思いました。それでもアルミンは下がりません。小さな体のまま、砲口とエレンのあいだに立ち続けます。
segments.en: The person who broke out of the ranks was Armin Arlert. His voice was shaking. Even so, he told the soldiers the same thing more than once. Eren was still human, and Eren was still on humanity's side. Kill him here, and they would also throw away the means to close the hole. Armin was not making a hero's speech. He was putting down, in a few words, the value of an operation, because that was how he could pull a friend back from execution. Some of the soldiers listening decided Armin was a dangerous ally. He still did not step back. Small as he was, he kept standing between the mouth of the cannon and Eren.

segments.ja: 火が出る直前、壁の上にドット・ピクシスが来ました。南部を預かる駐屯兵団の司令です。壁の外へ出る調査兵団ではなく、街と壁を守る側の人間です。年齢も、声の出し方も、慌てている若者たちとは違います。ピクシスは状況を尋ね、アルミンの話を最後まで聞きます。それから、砲を下ろすように命じました。これは許しの言葉ではありません。ピクシスはエレンを、危険な力を持った少年として見ています。同時に、その力を使わなければ作戦が始まらないことも分かっています。司令の判断は、好き嫌いではなく、今日の街を残すかどうかでした。
segments.en: Just before the cannon could fire, Dot Pyxis arrived on the wall. He is the Garrison commander responsible for the south. Not the Survey Corps, who ride outside, but the side that defends the city and the wall. His age, and the way he used his voice, were different from the panicked youths. Pyxis asked what the situation was, and he let Armin finish. Then he ordered the cannon lowered. That was not a speech of forgiveness. Pyxis looked at Eren as a boy carrying a dangerous power. At the same time, he understood that the operation could not start if that power was not used. The commander's judgment was not about liking or disliking anyone. It was about whether today's city would still be there.

segments.ja: ピクシスが壁の上で示した作戦は、図にすれば一本の線です。街の中、壊れた門の近くに、大きな岩があります。エレンが巨人になり、その岩を持ち上げて、穴の位置まで運ぶ。岩が扉の代わりにはまれば、巨人はトロスト区の奥へ進めません。難しいのは運ぶ途中です。道にはまだ巨人がいて、エレンの大きな体は狙われやすい。そこで精鋭の少数の班が動きます。立体機動装置で屋根から屋根へ飛び、巨人の注意を別の通りへ引きつける。エレンのための道を、ほんのしばらく空けるのです。成功すると決まった仕事ではありません。失敗すれば、岩を持つ者も、注意を引きつける兵も、死ぬかもしれません。
segments.en: The operation Pyxis described on the wall was a single line, if you drew it. Inside the city, near the broken gate, there was a great boulder. Eren would become a Titan, lift that rock, and carry it to the hole. If the rock sat where the gate had been, titans could not push deeper into Trost District. The hard part was the carrying. Titans were still on the road, and Eren's huge body would be easy to reach. So a few elite squads would move. They would jump from roof to roof with ODM gear and pull the titans' attention down other streets. Eren's road would be empty, but only for a little while. This was not a job that had already been declared a success. If it failed, the one holding the rock might die, and so might the soldiers drawing the titans away.

segments.ja: エレンは、自分の力をまだ分かっていません。巨人になるたび、意識が体から離れてしまう恐れがあります。岩を持ち上げられるかも、仲間を覚えたままでいられるかも、本人には約束できません。それでもエレンは、やると答えました。できる保証ではなく、やるという決断です。ピクシスはその答えを、若い兵の覚悟として受け取ります。責任の置き場は一つではありません。作戦を選んだのは司令です。岩を持つ役を引き受けたのはエレンです。その横で道を守ると決めた兵士も、自分の任務として立つことになります。
segments.en: Eren still did not understand his own power. Every time he became a Titan, he was afraid his mind would leave his body. He could not promise that he could lift the rock. He could not promise that he would still remember his friends while he did it. Even so, Eren answered that he would try. Not a guarantee of ability. A decision to act. Pyxis accepted that answer as a young soldier's resolve. The responsibility did not have one shelf to sit on. The commander had chosen the operation. Eren had taken the role of carrying the rock. And the soldiers who decided to guard that road would stand there as their own mission.

segments.ja: 作戦の前に、ピクシスは集まった兵全員へ話しました。美しい激励ではありません。食料と、人口と、失った領土の話です。ウォール・マリアが落ちてから、外の畑は使えなくなりました。避難した人々はウォール・ローゼの内側にいて、冬を越す食料が足りません。このまま時間だけが過ぎれば、上にいる人間は口減らしを考え始めます。人の数を減らして、残った分の食料を守ろうとする、冷たい計算です。ピクシスは、その未来を避けるには奪還しかない、と言いました。巨人は怖い。しかし、壁の中で人間が人間を切り捨てるほうが、もっと終わりに近い。今日の作戦は、名誉のためではなく、その計算を一日遅らせるためのものです。
segments.en: Before the operation, Pyxis spoke to every soldier gathered there. It was not a beautiful encouragement. It was a talk about food, about population, and about lost land. After Wall Maria fell, the fields outside could not be used. The people who fled were living inside Wall Rose, and there was not enough food to get through the winter. If nothing changed except the clock, the people above them would start thinking about reducing the number of mouths. A cold calculation: cut the number of people, and protect the food that remained. Pyxis said the only way to avoid that future was to take the land back. Titans are frightening. A future in which humans inside the walls throw other humans away is closer to the end. Today's operation was not for honor. It was a way to push that calculation back by one day.

segments.ja: 話が終わると、列は二つに割れました。任務を捨て、壁の内側へ降りていく兵士がいます。足が恐怖に従って動いてしまうのです。臆病者だと叫ぶ声もありましたが、背中を引き戻す力にはなりません。残った人数は多くありません。それでも精鋭のリーダーたちは自分の班へ戻り、開始の合図を配ります。ジャン・キルシュタインも、訓練を終えたばかりの若者たちと一緒に、屋根の位置へ散っていきました。希望があったから残ったのではありません。穴を開けたまま夜になるほうが、降りて逃げるより悪い、と体が判断したのです。死ぬかもしれない、という考えは、残った者のあいだではもう隠されていませんでした。
segments.en: When the speech ended, the ranks split in two. Some soldiers dropped the mission and climbed down inside the wall. Their feet simply obeyed their fear. People shouted that they were cowards, but the shouts were not strong enough to pull those backs around. Not many remained. Even so, the elite leaders returned to their squads and passed out the signal to begin. Jean Kirstein scattered to a rooftop position with other youths who had only just finished training. They did not stay because they felt hope. Their bodies had decided that nightfall, with the hole still open, was worse than climbing down and running. Among the people who remained, the thought that they might die was no longer hidden.

segments.ja: 作戦が開始されると、トロスト区の通りは音でいっぱいになります。精鋭の部隊は、巨人の目をこちらへ向けるために、わざと近くを飛びます。立体機動装置のガス、ワイヤーが建物に刺さる音、そして巨人の重い足音。その騒ぎのあいだに、エレンが進む一本の道だけが静かにされていきます。アルミンは配置を確認し、ミカサはエレンのそばを離れません。ミカサが守りたいのは、巨人の力そのものではありません。エレンが人間の意識のままでいられる、短い時間です。街の奥では、まだ建物が壊れています。成功の形は、まだ誰の目にも入っていません。
segments.en: When the operation began, the streets of Trost District filled with sound. The elite squads flew in close on purpose, so the titans would turn their eyes that way. Gas from the ODM gear, the noise of cables biting into buildings, and the heavy footsteps of titans. Inside that noise, only the one road Eren would walk was being made quiet. Armin checked the positions. Mikasa would not leave Eren's side. What she wanted to protect was not the Titan power itself. It was the short time in which Eren could remain conscious as a human. Deeper in the city, buildings were still coming down. The shape of success had not entered anyone's eyes yet.

segments.ja: エレンは巨人の体になり、岩の前まで来ます。ここで腕は岩の下へ入るはずでした。しかし伸びたのは、岩ではなく、近くにいたミカサのほうです。意識が落ち、体だけが動いています。仲間を守るために預けた力が、仲間を叩こうとしている。アルミンが呼んでも、その声は巨人の中まで届きません。作戦は始まったばかりで、すでに折れかけていました。この話が残す問いは単純です。巨人の力は、人間の兵器として使えるのか。それとも、使うと決めた人間の意思のほうが、先に折れるのか。答えはまだ、トロストの壁の下にはありません。
segments.en: Eren took a Titan's body and came as far as the boulder. This was the moment the arm should have gone under the rock. What reached out was not aimed at the rock. It was aimed toward Mikasa, who was close by. His mind had dropped away, and only the body was moving. The power he had offered so that his friends could be protected was trying to strike one of those friends. Armin called to him, and the voice did not arrive inside the Titan. The operation had only just started, and it was already folding. The question this story leaves is simple. Can a Titan's power be used as a human weapon. Or does the will of the human who decided to use it break first. The answer is not under Trost's wall yet.

segments.ja: 最後に、今日の言葉だけを声に出して置いておきます。巨人は、壁の外から来る脅威です。トロスト区は、穴の開いた街の名前です。駐屯兵団は、壁を守る兵士の集団です。調査兵団は壁の外へ出る兵団で、憲兵団は壁の内側の秩序を預かる兵団です。今日の通りに、その二つの姿はほとんど出てきません。作戦は、岩で壊れた扉を塞ぐ計画でした。精鋭は、その道を空ける少数の兵です。奪還は、失ったウォール・マリアを取り返すことです。口減らしは、食料が足りないときに人の数を減らそうとする冷たい考えです。覚悟は、成功すると分からなくても、やると決めることです。エレンが岩の前で見せたものも、そこで崩れたものも、この覚悟でした。次にこの言葉が物語の中で聞こえたら、今日の通りを思い出してください。
segments.en: Last, let's leave today's words by saying them aloud. A Titan is the threat that comes from outside the walls. Trost District is the name of the city with the hole. The Garrison Regiment is the body of soldiers who defend the walls. The Survey Corps is the regiment that goes outside the walls, and the Military Police Brigade is the regiment that keeps order inside them. Those two barely appear on today's streets. The operation was the plan to plug the broken gate with a boulder. The elites were the few soldiers clearing that road. Retaking means getting back the Wall Maria that was lost. Reducing the number of mouths is the cold idea of cutting the number of people when food runs short. Resolve is deciding to act even when you do not know that you will succeed. What Eren showed in front of the boulder, and what broke there, was that resolve. The next time you hear these words inside the story, remember today's street.

vocab.meaning: to aim at (with a weapon, etc.)
vocab.exampleJa: 砲が狙っているのは、外から来た敵ではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: The cannon was not aimed at an enemy from outside. It was aimed at Eren Jaeger, a boy who had eaten the same meals in the Training Corps. Eren had come out of the nape of a Titan's body, human-shaped again. He was hot to look at, and white steam still hung around him. He tried to call his friends' names, but the soldiers' terror moved faster than his words. There was a human face. And there was a Titan's power. For the soldiers watching, those two facts could not both be true. Mikasa Ackerman wanted to get in front of Eren, but the cannon's aim was settling first. Death here would not be a death inside a Titan's mouth. It would be a death decided by human judgment.

He still did not step back. Small as he was, he kept standing between the mouth of the cannon and Eren.
